subject: Onboarding playbook and MAP — SOC 2 / SIG-CAIQ / DPA / retention logistics
messages:
From: Emily Zhang <emily@stonebridge.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@stonebridge.com, Oliver Price <oliver@stonebridge.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding: what we need from Redwood on SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency numbers and the model routing options. We want to get a MAP in place that locks the security gates and timelines for our evaluation and procurement path. High-level asks from Stonebridge: 

- SOC 2 report and a short summary of controls we can share with our auditors.
- SIG/CAIQ status and any outstanding gaps.
- A DPA draft we can review; a few legal questions about retention windows for logs and backups.
- A clear acceptance checklist linking MAP milestones to required evidence.

I'm attaching our onboarding questionnaire to capture specifics (see attachment). Proposed timeline: 2-week evidence sprint starting 6/6, SIG completion by 6/20, legal DPA finalization by 6/28, decision by 7/1. Can Redwood commit to supporting that cadence?

If helpful, can you put together an ownership matrix (who provides what) and call out any items that need engineering time vs. product/CS artifacts?

Thanks,
Emily Zhang
Head of Cloud Ops, Stonebridge Capital

Attachment: stonebridge-initial-questionnaire.pdf

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Emily Zhang <emily@stonebridge.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: what we need from Redwood on SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention

Emily — really appreciate the clear timeline and questionnaire. Short answer: yes, we can support the cadence with a couple of caveats listed below. I've attached a concise SOC 2 summary and the current DPA draft with a few internal notes.

Proposed MAP outline (high level):
- 6/06–6/13: Evidence intake & ownership sprint (Redwood provides SOC 2 summary, control descriptions; Stonebridge completes specific evidence intake).
- 6/14–6/20: SIG/CAIQ gap closure — we'll target completing the CAIQ Q&A for items that are in-scope; any engineering-level gaps that require code changes will be flagged with estimated ETA.
- 6/21–6/27: Legal review & DPA redlines. We'll surface any non-standard retention requests early.
- 6/28–7/01: Final acceptance review and decision window.

Caveats / notes:
- Backup retention: we currently retain operational logs for 90 days by default; audit logs for 1 year in production clusters. We can support extended retention for audit exports but need to confirm SLA/backfill expectations (this may affect cost).
- SIG items that require product work (e.g., audit streaming endpoint) will be scoped separately; we should decide which items are must-have vs. nice-to-have for the initial acceptance.

Next steps I recommend: 1) confirm the evidence sprint start (6/06) and who from Stonebridge owns evidence intake; 2) review attached SOC 2 summary and DPA draft; 3) we'll prepare an evidence ownership spreadsheet and share it by EOD.

I'll attach the SOC 2 summary and the DPA draft here. Looping in Monica from Customer Success to drive evidence intake and Ben from Solutions for any SIG technical clarifications. Laura from legal will triage DPA redlines.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, dpa-draft-stonebridge-redlined.docx

From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: Emily Zhang <emily@stonebridge.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: what we need from Redwood on SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention

Emily — Monica here. We'll run the evidence intake sprint. Quick answers and an attached ownership matrix to make responsibilities explicit. Highlights: 

- Evidence ownership: Redwood will own the SOC 2 artifacts (system description, control narratives, test results); Stonebridge should upload any customer-side acceptance artifacts (sample traffic patterns, evaluation prompts, SSO test accounts) to the shared Drive folder.
- SIG/CAIQ: We can complete the narrative fields and provide screenshots for configuration items by 6/18. Engineering items (audit streaming, long-term immutable retention) are flagged in the matrix with owners and estimated completion dates.
- Retention requests: we can produce audit exports for the 7-year window, but long-term storage would be an export delivered to Stonebridge (S3 transfer) and will be part of a billable export workflow unless pre-provisioned.

I'll bring together a short intake template for Stonebridge to populate (who, what, where) and will share the evidence_ownership_matrix.xlsx in the Drive. If Stonebridge can assign a single point of contact for procurement/legal and a SRE for the SSO/test account, we'll be able to keep the sprint tight.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: evidence_ownership_matrix.xlsx

From: Oliver Price <oliver@stonebridge.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Emily Zhang <emily@stonebridge.com>, procurement@stonebridge.com
Date: Sat, 2 Jun 2028 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Onboarding: what we need from Redwood on SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention

Laura / Karthik — thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple of legal questions on the DPA before we start the sprint: 

1) Retention: Stonebridge requires auditable logs for 7 years for compliance. We understand Redwood's default windows but need a firm approach for how long-term retention will be handled and whether Redwood will accept liability for backups stored on a customer-managed S3.
2) Subprocessors: please confirm current subprocessors list and whether Redwood will notify us of changes within 30 days.
3) Data deletion: need explicit wording on deletion timelines post-contract and the format of exported artifacts.

I've attached a short list of redlines to the DPA (see attached redlined doc). If we can lock retention semantics this week, procurement can proceed with the PO and DocuSign routing.

Regards,
Oliver Price
Sr. Counsel, Stonebridge Capital

Attachment: dpa-redlines-stonebridge.docx

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Oliver Price <oliver@stonebridge.com>, Emily Zhang <emily@stonebridge.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, procurement@stonebridge.com
Date: Sat, 2 Jun 2028 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: what we need from Redwood on SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention

Oliver / Emily — thanks for the redlines and the retention callout. Quick summary and agreed actions so we can keep to Stonebridge's timeline: 

Agreed points / next steps:
- Retention: Redwood confirms we will provide 7-year audit exports as a delivered export (S3 or secure transfer). Redwood will not host customer-specific seven-year retention in the default tenant; long-term export is treated as an export + storage deliverable and will be included in the statement of work as a fixed one-time export fee + optional ongoing archival fee. Monica to scope the export process and estimate costs by EOD Monday.
- Subprocessors: Laura will produce the current subprocessors list and confirm a 30-day notification commitment in the DPA; she will upload the list to the Drive.
- Data deletion: Redwood will provide a deletion certificate and an exported archive in standard NDJSON/CSV for data types in scope; details to be added to DPA.

Operationally: Monica will kick off the evidence intake on 6/06 and share the intake template. Ben will own SIG technical questions and will schedule a 45-minute call on 6/08 to walk through any flagged engineering items. Laura will take the DPA redlines and propose language to address retention and subprocessors by Monday EOD.

If that sounds good, Emily, please confirm your PoC for evidence intake and whether procurement will need a revised signature flow for DocuSign. We'll aim to have SIG narrative items done by 6/18 and DPA agreed by 6/28 as you proposed.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth sprint.

Best regards,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales Lead, Redwood Inference

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-Redwood-Onboarding-Docs
Attachments referenced: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, dpa-draft-stonebridge-redlined.docx
